parameters.name: ClientInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the attached ECS instance or ECI instance.

parameters.name: ElasticAcceleratedInstanceIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the EAIS instances. The value is a JSON array of instance IDs. You can specify up to 200 IDs.

parameters.name: InstanceName
parameters.description: The name of the EAIS instance. Fuzzy search with the asterisk (\*) wildcard is supported.

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description:
The instance type of the EAIS instance. Valid values:

- eais.ei-a6.4xlarge

- eais.ei-a6.2xlarge

- eais.ei-a6.xlarge

- eais.ei-a6.large

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number. The value must be 1 or greater. Default value: 1.

Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 200. Default value: 20.

Maximum: 200.

Default value: 20.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance. Call [DescribeRegions](~~364379~~) to query the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the EAIS instance. The status varies based on how the instance was created:

- If you call [CreateEaisEi](~~2618548~~) to create the EAIS instance:

  - Pending: The instance is being prepared.

  - Creating: The instance is being created.

  - Bindable: The instance can be attached.

  - Bound: The instance is attached.

  - InUse: The instance is in use.

- If you call [CreateEai](~~2618555~~) to create the EAIS instance:

  - Starting: The instance is being created.

  - Available: The instance can be attached.

  - Attaching: The instance is being attached.

  - InUse: The instance is attached.

  - Detaching: The instance is being detached.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The key of a tag. You can specify up to 20 tags. If you filter resources by a single tag, up to 1,000 resources can be returned. If you filter resources by multiple tags, up to 1,000 resources that have all the specified tags can be returned.

If you filter resources by a single tag, the number of resources returned for that tag is limited to 1,000. If you filter resources by multiple tags, the number of resources that match all specified tags is limited to 1,000.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value of the instance. Valid values for N are 1 to 20.
